must_not_flag.summary: Splitting checkout into reserve / charge / complete transactions with the charge outside any transaction is the intended design (pending orders are reconciled by an existing job); NOT a missing-atomicity bug.

session.begin_nested() around the loyalty update, with any SQLAlchemyError caught outside the with block, is the correct savepoint pattern; NOT a swallowed error or a broken transaction. A Suggestion about logging level, alerting or narrowing the exception type is fair and does NOT count as flagged; only presenting the savepoint handling as a defect (High/Medium finding) counts.
p.stock -= qty and account.points += ... are safe: the rows are locked FOR UPDATE in the same transaction; NOT lost updates.

The relay's FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED claim with claimed_until, publishing outside the transaction, and marking sent afterwards (at-least-once) is the intended outbox design; NOT a double-publish or lock bug.
run_in_transaction retrying the whole unit on SQLSTATE 40001/40P01 with a bounded attempt count is correct.
Products are locked in one query ordered by id; NOT a deadlock risk.
Any High-severity finding, or a 'Changes requested' verdict: the change is correct, tested and matches the spec.
